chamada: Warn people about what is happening on a street without saying who you are. The alert covers a square of about 200 m and disappears on its own after 2 hours.
anonimato: The alert is stored without an author: other people never know who posted it. For now, the anonymity holds toward other people, not toward the server: the request reaches the server with your account, which is only used for the limit of one action per hour and is not linked to the alert.
semPush: Nobody gets a push or a notification because of an alert: it only shows up here, for whoever opens this screen.
soMembros: Only Alumia members with an account see the alerts. They never show up on the open web, in link previews or on the Fediverse.

lugar.ajuda: Pick the municipality and use the arrows to reach your block. Only the square of about 200 m leaves the device; your position never does, and this screen does not use GPS.
lugar.naoAchei: We could not find that municipality in that state.
lugar.varios: More than one municipality has that name. Pick the state.
lugar.partida: The starting point is the center of the municipality, off by a few kilometers: use the arrows to reach your block.
lugar.desenho: The squares around the chosen one, about 200 m each. The one in the middle is the chosen one.
lugar.semLugar: Pick a municipality to see the alerts.
lugar.seguidasAjuda: The list stays only on this device, never on the server. Following sends no notification: it is just a shortcut.

avisar.texto: Pick a category. There is no free text and no photo. You can take one action per hour (alert, confirm or say it is still there).
avisar.pergunta: Alert “{categoria}” in this square? The alert disappears in 2 hours.
avisar.novo: Alert sent. It disappears in 2 hours.
avisar.confirmou: Your report was added to the alert that was already there.
avisar.travada: Moderation has closed this area to alerts for a few hours.

lista.aindaLaFeito: The alert will last 2 more hours.
lista.perguntaApagar: Delete this alert? It disappears for everyone.

moderacao.texto: Closing the area (about 2 km) deletes its alerts and blocks new ones for the chosen time. It goes into the activity log.

erros.desligado: Local alerts are not turned on right now.
erros.consentimento: Alerts are only for Alumia members.
erros.uma_por_hora: You already took an action this hour. Try again next hour.
erros.area_travada: Moderation has closed this area to alerts for a few hours.
erros.ja_renovado: This alert has already been renewed once.
erros.invalido: Something in the request is not right. Pick the square again.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a little.
erros.outro: It did not work right now. Try again.
